byHand.reason: the category description is rich text an administrator writes in the WYSIWYG, so it carries markup on purpose and printing it escaped would show the tags
byHand.guarantee: MageObsidian\Catalog\ViewModel\CategoryLanding::getDescriptionHtml returns Magento\Catalog\Helper\Output::categoryAttribute, which applies the allowed-HTML policy and the CMS directive filter, exactly as core's view.phtml does

byHand.reason: the short description is rich text an administrator writes, and carries markup on purpose
byHand.guarantee: MageObsidian\Catalog\ViewModel\ProductView::getShortDescriptionHtml routes it through Magento\Catalog\Helper\Output::productAttribute, the same filter core's view.phtml applies

byHand.reason: the product description is rich text an administrator writes, and carries markup on purpose
byHand.guarantee: MageObsidian\Catalog\ViewModel\ProductView::getDescriptionHtml routes it through Magento\Catalog\Helper\Output::productAttribute, the same filter core's view.phtml applies

byHand.reason: a visible-on-front product attribute value, taken straight from Magento\Catalog\Block\Product\View\Attributes::getAdditionalData and printed unescaped

defect.detail: core's attributes.phtml prints the same value through Magento\Catalog\Helper\Output::productAttribute, which escapes every attribute that is not on the allowed-HTML list and resolves CMS directives; this template skips the helper, so an administrator (or an integration with catalog write access) can put markup into any visible attribute and the storefront will render it, and {{media url=...}} inside an attribute never resolves

byHand.reason: a product attribute value on the comparison table, taken straight from Magento\Catalog\Block\Product\Compare\ListCompare::getProductAttributeValue

defect.detail: core's compare/list.phtml routes the same value through Magento\Catalog\Helper\Output::productAttribute and escapes it when it is not a string; this template prints it unescaped, so it is the same divergence as the product page's spec list

byHand.reason: the per-option price configuration, embedded in a script of type application/json that the browser does not execute
byHand.guarantee: Magento\Catalog\Block\Product\View\Options::getJsonConfig builds a map of option id to price numbers and booleans; no option title or any other free text reaches it, so nothing in it can carry a closing script tag

byHand.reason: the country and region list for the dependent select, embedded in a script of type application/json that the browser does not execute
byHand.guarantee: the values come from directory_country_region, which is reference data shipped with Magento and only reachable through a data patch, not through any storefront or admin form

byHand.reason: this is the shopper's own search term reflected back into the page heading, which is the classic reflected-XSS position
byHand.guarantee: Magento\CatalogSearch\Block\Result::getSearchQueryText wraps Magento\Search\Helper\Data::getEscapedQueryText, which truncates the term and runs it through Escaper::escapeHtml before it is ever returned

byHand.reason: a search warning message, emitted unescaped because the phrase may carry markup
byHand.guarantee: Magento\Search\Helper\Data::checkNotes is the only producer, and it adds one fixed translated phrase whose single argument is the configured maximum query length, a number

byHand.reason: a layered-navigation filter label: either an attribute option an administrator defined, or a price range that the filter renders as markup, which is why it cannot be escaped
byHand.guarantee: core's own layer/filter.phtml prints the same value with @noEscape at both of its call sites, so this matches the platform's behaviour rather than relaxing it

byHand.reason: a per-address shipping error message produced by the multishipping flow
byHand.guarantee: Magento\Multishipping\Block\Checkout\Results::getAddressError only reads the messages the multishipping checkout model put in the session, which are translated phrases the module itself builds

byHand.expression: block.getOverflow().getStyle(links, { container: '...', tracking: 0.16, chevron: 16, moreLabel: moreLabel, moreExtra: 18, uppercase: true, gaps: [{ gap: 24 }, { from: 1280, gap: 32 }] })
byHand.reason: the generated stylesheet that decides how many nav items fit before the overflow menu takes over
byHand.guarantee: MageObsidian\Storefront\ViewModel\NavOverflow::getStyle reduces every category label to a cell count through cells(), and emits only that number, the container class it was given and media queries; no label text reaches the stylesheet, so nothing in it can close the style element

byHand.reason: Magento's inline-translation hook, which is a whole attribute rather than an attribute value, so escaping it would print it as text inside the tag
byHand.guarantee: the value is whatever the layout set on Magento\Theme\Block\Html\Title, which is developer-authored layout XML; core's own title.phtml emits it the same way

byHand.reason: the comment a shopper typed on a wish list item, which is end-user content
byHand.guarantee: Magento\Wishlist\Block\AbstractBlock::getEscapedDescription returns Escaper::escapeHtml of the description, or a non-breaking space when there is none; the accessor exists precisely so the caller can print it raw

byHand.reason: the comment a shopper typed on a wish list item, shown on the shared list
byHand.guarantee: Magento\Wishlist\Block\AbstractBlock::getEscapedDescription returns Escaper::escapeHtml of the description, or a non-breaking space when there is none

byHand.reason: a ternary between two string literals written in the template — it emits either disabled="disabled" or nothing, and no value from outside the file reaches it
byHand.guarantee: both branches are literals in the template itself

byHand.reason: the payment method's configured title, printed twice in the same template
byHand.guarantee: $title is assigned as $escaper->escapeHtml($block->getMethod()->getTitle()) at the top of the same file, which is why the echo carries @noEscape

byHand.reason: the critical CSS the build produced for this page type, inlined into the head so the first paint needs no stylesheet
byHand.guarantee: the value is a file the deploy wrote from the theme's own stylesheets; nothing a request carries reaches it, and escaping CSS as HTML would break every rule in it
